searchText: Update on the EELS release for BAL Devnet-2, we are [4](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pulls?q=is%3Apr+milestone%3A"bal+devnet-2"+is%3Aclosed) out of [7](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pulls?q=is%3Apr+milestone%3A"bal+devnet-2"+is%3Aopen) PRs merged. We'll try to make a release in the coming days for everyone to consume the tests and validate implementations! Started collecting data here, will update as I go, only one full day so far... https://hackmd.io/@siladu/H11EKOkLZx TLDR: measured 517MiB increase in 24 hours, so projected annual growth of 184 GiB. Obviously 24 hours is not very representative so will continue measuring. Will also look into supporting `debug_stateSize` RPC and getting Besu's data alongside Geth's on https://lab.ethpandaops.io/ethereum/execution/state-growth Can you break the growth down by area? Yep added it here https://hackmd.io/@siladu/H11EKOkLZx#Net-growth-per-state-column-family-24h and raw data linked as well now. This looks great, Simon! 👏 Is there any way to collect historical data that covers the gas limit increases from the past year (30->36, 36->45, 45->60)? I’ve been wondering that as appears to have been done for Geth for the lab data. Maybe can estimate by analysing historical txs somehow. **ACDC <t:1769090400:R>** Agenda: <https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1874> Stream: <https://youtube.com/watch?v=APiyToa6UmI> Zoom: <https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/81973476602?pwd=L8ob6xqxvsaDcFe92c6Us5NxCupqpH.1> I’ve been wondering that as appears to anyone from teku, is there a post-mortem or writeup of the mainnet issues enrico mentioned on the call? we are preparing it. It will come up once we have all things sorted ACDC 173

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: Update on the EELS release for BAL Devnet-2, we are [4](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pulls?q=is%3Apr+milestone%3A"bal+devnet-2"+is%3Aclosed) out of [7](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pulls?q=is%3Apr+milestone%3A"bal+devnet-2"+is%3Aopen) PRs merged. We'll try to make a release in the coming days for everyone to consume the tests and validate implementations!
